{{Quote|Traitor!|Saw Gerrera after Pluti's death and betrayal|<ref name="IHFE" />}}
'''Pluti''' was a member of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] in [[3 BBY]].<ref name="EBtG" /> Secretly an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[spy]],<ref name="IHFE" /><ref name="Explained">{{SW|url=news/andor-explained-season-2-highlights-episodes-4-5-6|text=''Andor'' Explained: Episodes 4-6 - "Ever Been to Ghorman?", "I Have Friends Everywhere", and "What a Festive Evening"}}</ref> Pluti was present at the Partisans' base on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]]. He worked with [[Wilmon Paak]] to prepare a [[Rhydonium fuel pipe siphon|device]] for safe [[rhydonium]] extraction. Pluti later pressed Gerrera for information on where the Partisans would be stealing the rhydonium from as well as to bring Paak along for the raid. Unaware that Gerrera had suspected his duplicity, Pluti transmitted to the Empire that the Partisans would be hitting the [[Markez Moon pipeline]], shortly before Gerrera [[Death|killed]] Pluti and left his body behind as the Partisans departed D'Qar.<ref name="EBtG" />
